findings: `historical_glyphs.items[0]` (attachment 1, `ba-oracle`) and `items[1]` (attachment 2, `fu-oracle`) are component redraws, not historical attestations of 爸. Recast these as component-form illustrations, and keep their role in 爸 explicitly an attributed analysis rather than an inference from the drawings.
